name: Todd Brown
headline: Vice President Services and AI, HPE
about:
A seasoned leader with a strong track record of initiative and achievement in the areas of Professional Service strategy and experience. Established record of excellence in Professional Service practices within multiple customer segments with focus on business to business and consumer markets. A strong team leader with abilities to initiate change, improve operational efficiencies and develop new initiatives while maintaining a positive and productive environment. Demonstrated success directing the development of organizations during periods of tremendous growth. Recognized for results that significantly increase loyalty, revenue growth and profitability.

Specialties: Professional Services, Client Service Management, Customer Service Experience design, Merger and acquisitions, Project Management, Field Service design and delivery, Call Center expertise, Customer Care Operations, Operations Management

experiences.position: Vice President Worldwide Professional Services and Managed Services
Vice President, HPE Services and AI

experiences.description:
Pinnacle Wireless, wireless communications systems integrator, specializes in large-scale communications projects for state\local public safety government entities, transportation, entertainment, hospitality and enterprise-grade commercial real estate and carrier build services.

Responsible for providing effective leadership and mentoring to the Technical Support Management team to provide guidance achieving defined customer satisfaction and operational performance goals.  Establish the vision for ongoing support evolution supporting the key Pinnacle Wireless initiatives.

Responsible  for ensuring the effective execution of daily operations, meeting and exceeding service level agreements, and the effective execution of continuous improvement and change initiatives.

Implemented an enhanced service structure, leveraging technical support as "best in class" market differentiator, resulting in a 100% increase in the company service revenue and customer satisfaction.

experiences.position: Regional Service Manager, Government & Commercial Markets Services Organization
experiences.description:
Lead the Managed Services field team, focused on Motorola’s largest Public Safety customer base located in the Northeast and Mid-Atlantic Regions. Developed customized approach for maximizing the effectiveness of a customer organization's wireless communications system, ensuring that their system met the organization's business and financial objectives. The team developed and implemented an integrated services solution to optimally manage the lifecycle costs and operations of the customers critical public safety wireless communications while significantly increasing customer loyalty and revenue growth.

Specific Accomplishments:


•	Strategically managed and built a $50M portfolio of global accounts (City of NY-DoITT, Connecticut State Police, State of Rhode Island, City of Philadelphia); worked with corporate managers and “C-Level” management to promote expansion of products and services.

•	Increased revenue $25M in over a two year period while dramatically impacting customer satisfaction and loyalty. 
•	Hired\developed and trained over 15 System Manager technical experts for customer implementations.
•	Successfully negotiated profitable annual & multi-year and multi-million dollar contracts for wireless and ancillary services.

experiences.position: Vice President, Business Customer Care Operations
experiences.description:

Team was developed to build organizational capabilities by ensuring the alignment of systems, processes and communications with the goals of the organization.  Overall charter was to increase operational efficiencies, establishment of critical strategic relationships, improve employee relations, achieve organizational MBO goals and increase customer satisfaction.
In addition, accountable for directing the efforts and activities of the Business Care Operations Support Center located in Temple, Texas, including designing and implementing processes and programs that ensured the delivery of outstanding service in support of the National Field Care service organization.

Managed seven national functional groups with an annual operating budget of $ 74 million and 900 employees responsible for maintaining over $2 billion in revenues.

Developed and deployed a premier customer service department of 30 employees.  Generated over $8 million in annual telemarketing sales.
